regime_context: The detector shows a defensive, high-durability regime: Big Pharma is headline (trending, broad, crowded) but Memory/HBM ranks #1 on raw momentum while being trend-gate INELIGIBLE. Eligible leadership is concentrated in healthcare/staples/defensives, all crowded; the 0.39 eligible fraction and 0.32 absorption with 'narrowing' breadth describe a defensive, non-rotational tape. The absolute-trend gate does help drawdown control on this market's history.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Memory/HBM (rank 1, score 1.712) regains trend-gate eligibility — if its durability_bar rises back above ~0.5 and SMH flips eligible, that would retire this watch and demand a reassessment of the defensive-leadership read.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the only top-rank theme that combines a strong trend-gate eligibility with high durability (0.84) and full breadth (1.0). The detector's one validated edge is trend-gate staying-power; crowdedness (z=1.46) is a size-down caution, not a fade. This is a defensive leadership lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowded at z=1.46 and headline status could mean the theme has already been well-discovered; attention spikes mark tops; any single policy/patent shock flows straight through concentrated pharma holdings.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by more than 3% over any rolling 10-day window inside the 30-day horizon

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: EW healthcare (XLV) is eligible, high-durability (0.78), and broad (0.917). It captures the same defensive leadership as Big Pharma but with less single-name concentration. Crowding (1.54) again only argues for sizing discipline.
theses.dissent: Health sector's crowdedness is the highest in the eligible set — defensive flows may be late-stage; XLV's heavy weight to lagging managed-care names could dilute a pure pharma uptrend.

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by more than 5% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is eligible but shows durability of only 0.48 with zero breadth (0.0) — an isolated, narrow trend that the validated stay-power leg says is not a reliable leadership. Rank 6 momentum does not offset weak breadth/durability.
theses.dissent: Energy can re-rate violently on a supply shock or geopolitical headline; macro narrative shows an energy theme surfacing; being unowned in a low-breadth advance is exactly where short squeezes start.

falsifier.text: XLE outperforms SPY by 4% or more over any rolling 5-day window inside the 20-day horizon

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
